channel.title: Zach Boogher — Blog
channel.description: Infrastructure automation, the homelab, and the occasional round of golf.

item.title: A 9.3 landed in a framework I ship on. Here is what I did about it.
item.description: CVE-2026-103922 hits Capacitor, which my golf app is built on. I was on an affected version. What the flaw is, how I checked, and what it takes to actually protect the people using it.

item.title: Parbaughs Golf Club: the app I wrote so nobody has to argue about the math
item.description: It started as one HTML file. It is now a real build with handicaps to the USGA standard, live leaderboards and a native app on a phone. Most of what I learned was not about golf.

item.title: The accounts nobody was counting
item.description: Our RMM knows every account that exists. It has no good way to show you which ones have stopped being used. Across a few hundred client organizations, that gap was the whole problem.

item.title: Two hundred and sixty-five appliances, by hand
item.description: Nobody said it could not be done. They said it was becoming an enormous amount of work and the end of it was hard to see. That is a different problem, and a more interesting one.

item.title: Lancaster, a caddie, and the first place that is actually mine
item.description: Somebody asked what I was looking forward to and I did not have an answer ready, which felt like a problem worth fixing. Not a technical post.
